content.text:
The cause was a wrong entry in the error catalog. In `errcatalog/warehouse.go`, `"warehouse.limit"` was mapped to `api.CodeInternal`, which `api.HTTPStatus` turns into a 500. I changed it to `api.CodeQuota`, which maps to 429 Too Many Requests.

That is the only line changed. The other warehouse mappings, including `warehouse.timeout` (still `CodeInternal`), are as they were. The other domains' `*.limit` entries already use `CodeQuota`, so warehouse now matches them.

`go test ./...` passes. I didn't add a test that checks `warehouse.limit` returns 429.

That is the only line changed. The other warehouse mappings, including `warehouse.timeout` (still `CodeInternal`), are as they were. The other domains' `*.limit` entries already use `CodeQuota`, so warehouse now matches them.

`go test ./...` passes. I didn't add a test that checks `warehouse.limit` returns 429.
